title: Melepurath Sankunni Ezhuthassan v Thekittil Geopalankutty Nair

content.caseIdentity: Melepurath Sankunni Ezhuthassan v Thekittil Geopalankutty Nair, (1986) 1 SCC 118
content.facts: Death-related claims depend on statutory cause of action; an estate claim and a dependency claim must not be conflated.
questionsBeforeCourt: What legal rule governs the doctrine?
content.ratioDecidendi: Death-related claims depend on statutory cause of action; an estate claim and a dependency claim must not be conflated.
content.holding: Death-related claims depend on statutory cause of action; an estate claim and a dependency claim must not be conflated.
content.relevance: Apply the ratio to the proved facts.
